conf.description: Trellix ePO, ens-threat, syslog-cef: CEF header + fixed-order extension-key regex_extract (no Cribl CEF-parse function exists; cef is a serializer), severity invert, ThreatActionTaken partial decode, DOMAIN\user split; keeps _raw per recommendations.direct.cribl (malware detections are the forensic class, hand-built parser unproven).

conf.comment: trellix-epo/ens-threat/syslog-cef. No Cribl pack or Elastic integration exists for on-prem ePO, so this hand-built parser owns the whole shape per recommendations.direct.cribl. The extension key order below (DetectedUTC...TargetHash) is assumed fixed, matching the field order this work order documents for the registered-syslog CEF push; a differently-ordered or truncated extension will fail the single regex match below (see README gap).

functions.description: identify technology, dataset, format, and parsing approach

conf.regex: /CEF:\d+\|[^|]*\|[^|]*\|[^|]*\|[^|]*\|[^|]*\|[^|]*\|DetectedUTC=(?<DetectedUTC>.*?) ReceivedUTC=(?<ReceivedUTC>.*?) ThreatEventID=(?<ThreatEventID>.*?) ThreatName=(?<ThreatName>.*?) ThreatType=(?<ThreatType>.*?) ThreatCategory=(?<ThreatCategory>.*?) ThreatSeverity=(?<ThreatSeverity>.*?) ThreatActionTaken=(?<ThreatActionTaken>.*?) ThreatHandled=(?<ThreatHandled>.*?) AnalyzerName=(?<AnalyzerName>.*?) AnalyzerDetectionMethod=(?<AnalyzerDetectionMethod>.*?) AnalyzerDATVersion=(?<AnalyzerDATVersion>.*?) SourceIPV4=(?<SourceIPV4>.*?) SourceProcessName=(?<SourceProcessName>.*?) SourceUserName=(?<SourceUserName>.*?) TargetHostName=(?<TargetHostName>.*?) TargetIPV4=(?<TargetIPV4>.*?) TargetUserName=(?<TargetUserName>.*?) TargetFileName=(?<TargetFileName>.*?) TargetHash=(?<TargetHash>\S*)$/

functions.description: split the CEF pipe-delimited header (discarded, not needed for ECS) from the ePO threat-event extension key=value pairs, extracting each known extension key as a named group so a space-containing value (e.g. AnalyzerName, ThreatName) is bounded by the next literal key name rather than truncated by a naive kv split
batch-rename status:mapped extension fields (or partial fields whose CEF-path value needs no transform) to their ECS target

decode/normalize the partial and unmapped extension fields (severity invert, ThreatActionTaken partial decode, ThreatHandled bool, DOMAIN\user split), set _time from DetectedUTC per recommendations (not syslog receipt time), and tag event.dataset
Re-nest flat dotted keys (data-maps canonical step)
